notes: Event date: 9 November 1944, noon (Stacey, p. 428). II, p. 159, has it moved back to Belgium on the 29th, where it is reduced to cadre strength and then goes to the United Kingdom as a training division (the page does not name the month; read with Stacey it is 29 November).
